spec_definition_review.mathematical_semantics: The success branch fixes logical FIFO contents to nil and physical allocation contents to repeat None via xizi_circular_area_uninitialized. CircularAreaBackingResource owns all descriptor fields and UCharArray.mixed_full, so it does not claim initialized byte values. The failure branch exposes exactly the canonical allocation-failure resource.
spec_definition_review.sub_four_behavior: The production precondition 0 < requested <= 256 is preserved. For requested 1..3, alignment is zero and buffer_alloc_spec cannot take its non-null branch because that branch requires size > 0; therefore only the canonical failure branch can be reached.
spec_definition_review.undef_to_mixed_derivation: UCharArray.undef_full_to_mixed_full is available in ArrayLibCore and is used only in its provided undef_full-to-mixed_full direction by generated obligations/strategies.
